newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's 4 bln-pound bond offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's 4 bln-pound bond offer oversubscribed.

text.p: The Egyptian Central Bank's offer of coupon bonds worth four billion pounds was about 2.5 times oversubscribed, an official at the bank said on Tuesday.
"The subscription reached 10.119 billion pounds," Mostafa Eweiss, the official in charge of bond issues at the bank, told Reuters. "The allocation was 39.53 percent."
The seven year bonds carry a rate of 11 percent.

Monday was the closing day of the offer. The short-term Egyptian pound money market saw little dealing on Monday as bankers waited to see what their allocations would be in the new bonds, the bankers said.
"Banks are holding on to what they have, because of the treasury bonds. Even the public-sector banks are not lending for the moment," one banker said.
